title: MaxRecognition
description: MAXGEN 2.0 -- One MaxRecognition document is one machine reading (OCR of print or HTR of handwriting) of one image, kept with its per-word confidences so that readings of the same image can be compared; who or what made the reading is recorded on the task that produced it.

recognition_id.description: Random id of this reading, created once by its writer and never reused.

recognition_type.description: What kind of text was read: ocr for printed or typed text, htr for handwritten text, other (with recognition_type_as_written) for anything else.

recognition_type_as_written.description: The reading program's own word for the kind of reading, written when recognition_type is other.

image_url.description: Address of the image that was read, never invented; at least one of image_url and raw_record_id is required.

raw_record_id.description: The MaxRecord whose image this reading read; at least one of image_url and raw_record_id is required.

copy_sha256.description: Fingerprint of the saved copy that was read (described on raw_record_id, or on the live record that holds that copy), the same copy that evidence links cite.

region_id.description: The marked region of that saved copy that was read, when only part of the image was read.

output_text.description: The full text this reading produced, as plain text or as a JSON-encoded string of structured lines or words.

processed_at.description: When this reading was produced (UTC); renamed from the 1.x processing_date.

language.description: Language of the document that was read, as a language code such as de, la or en.

confidence.description: Overall confidence the reader reported for the whole reading, 0 to 1, kept as reported and never computed by the kit.

word_confidences.description: One item per word read, with its confidence, how it was produced, other readings considered and where it sits on the image.

character_error_rate.description: Character error rate measured against a checked reference text, when one exists.

word_error_rate.description: Word error rate measured against a checked reference text, when one exists.

consensus_group_id.description: A grouping label shared by several readings of the same image so they can be compared; it names no MAXGEN document.

redistribution_license.description: Licence of this reading's text; tier2-private when the image is rights-restricted or anyone named may be alive.

is_living_flag.description: Living A: true if anyone named in this reading may be alive, and true when unsure; a floor the kit only raises, and true requires tier2-private.

attribution.description: Credit for a human transcriber or the organization that made the reading; a credit never sets a living flag.

font_type.description: Printed readings: the main kind of typeface on the page (other with font_type_as_written).

font_type_as_written.description: The reader's own words for the typeface, written when font_type is other.

scan_dpi.description: Printed readings: the scan resolution of the image in dots per inch.

script_type.description: Handwritten readings: the handwriting script family of the document (other with script_type_as_written).

script_type_as_written.description: The reader's own words for the script, written when script_type is other.

approx_century.description: Handwritten readings: the rough age of the handwriting as the first year of its century (1800 means the 1800s).

searchable_variants.description: Every spelling this reading should be findable under, including uncertain readings and normalised forms.

read_blind.description: MAXGEN 2.1 (G-30): true when the image was read before the reader saw any index or other reading of it, so the reading is independent; false when it was read after seeing one.

based_on_recognition_id.description: MAXGEN 2.1 (G-30): the reading this one started from and corrected; what changed is worked out by comparing the two.

field_comparison.description: MAXGEN 2.1 (G-11): how this reading compares with an index of the same image, field by field, as the reader judged it.
MAXGEN 2.1 (G-11): one field of one person or line, as the image and the index give it.

mention_ref.description: Which person or line of the index the field belongs to, as the reader wrote it.

field.description: The field compared, as written (name, age, birthplace ...).

page_value.description: What the image says, as read.

result.description: The image and the index agree, differ, or the image is unclear there.

word_confidence.description: One word of the reading with its confidence.

char_offset.description: Character position of this word in output_text.

confidence.description: The reader's confidence in this word, 0 to 1.

reading_type.description: How the word was produced: observed (read from the image; the meaning when left out), inferred_context (filled in from nearby entries), inferred_pattern (filled in from known naming or place patterns), partial_read (some characters read, the rest inferred), or other with reading_type_as_written.

reading_type_as_written.description: The reader's own words for how the word was produced, written when reading_type is other.

inference_notes.description: Why the word was inferred rather than read, written whenever reading_type is anything other than observed; it is the trail a reviewer follows.

alternatives.description: Other readings of this word the reader considered, each with its confidence.

text.description: The other reading of the word.

confidence.description: The reader's confidence in this other reading, 0 to 1.

bbox.description: Where the word sits on the image that was read.
A box on the image: left, top, width and height in pixels, fractions (0 to 1) or percent (0 to 100), with an optional page number.

unit.description: The unit of x, y, w and h: px, fraction (0 to 1) or percent (0 to 100).

page.description: Page of a multi-page file the box is on.
